evidence: finalsource/be/src/modules/goal/goal.controller.ts:59-75 protects GET /api/v1/goals with JwtAuthGuard and passes only request.user.userId to GoalService
finalsource/be/src/modules/goal/goal.service.ts:72-87 scopes saving goals, expense goals, and accounts by the authenticated userId
finalsource/be/src/modules/goal/goal.service.ts:89-95 restricts contributing transactions to account IDs obtained from that owned-account query
requirements.rationale: The endpoint derives identity from the validated JWT request context, accepts no client user identifier, and source-scopes all goals, accounts, and contributing transactions to that identity.

evidence: finalsource/be/src/modules/goal/goal.service.ts:72-74 calls findOne using only userId and SAVING type
The saving-goal query has no valid-range or current-month-overlap predicate and no latest-start/highest-goalId ordering
requirements.rationale: An ineligible or nondeterministically chosen saving goal can be returned when multiple persisted saving goals exist.

evidence: finalsource/be/src/modules/goal/goal.service.ts:75-83 filters owned expense-limit goals by month overlap
The query does not enforce startDate <= endDate and therefore does not establish all-and-only valid-range eligibility
requirements.rationale: Ownership, type, and overlap are present, but invalid persisted ranges can satisfy the two independent overlap predicates and be returned.

evidence: finalsource/be/src/modules/goal/goal.service.ts:90-95 loads transactions for the entire current calendar month
finalsource/be/src/modules/goal/goal.service.ts:97-110 calculates saving progress from that full-month set without intersecting the selected goal's own startDate/endDate
requirements.rationale: Owned revenue-minus-expense and negative values are preserved, but transactions outside a shorter goal interval can contribute.

evidence: finalsource/be/src/modules/goal/goal.service.ts:90-95 retrieves one shared full-month transaction set
finalsource/be/src/modules/goal/goal.service.ts:115-124 filters by expense type and category but not by each expense goal's own startDate/endDate overlap interval
requirements.rationale: Category, expense type, and ownership are enforced, but a transaction outside an individual goal interval can contribute to currentExpense.

evidence: finalsource/be/src/modules/goal/goal.service.ts:109-110 and 118-124 convert monetary values to numbers but do not explicitly round them to two decimal places
finalsource/be/src/modules/goal/goal.service.ts:117 returns Unknown for both null categoryId and unresolved category names and does not trim a resolved name
requirements.rationale: The required null-category fallback, resolved-name trimming, and complete two-decimal normalization are absent.

evidence: finalsource/be/src/modules/goal/goal.service.ts:75-83 calls Repository.find without an order option
finalsource/be/src/modules/goal/goal.service.ts:115-125 maps expense goals in repository-returned order and the frontend preserves that array order
requirements.rationale: The exceeded-status priority and endDate, targetAmount, and goalId tie-breaker order are not implemented.

evidence: finalsource/be/src/modules/goal/goal.controller.ts:59-75 protects GET /api/v1/goals with JwtAuthGuard and passes request.user.userId only
finalsource/be/src/modules/goal/goal.service.ts:72-100 scopes both goal queries and the account query to that authenticated userId
finalsource/be/src/modules/goal/goal.service.ts:101-123 limits contributing transactions to IDs from the owned-account query
requirements.rationale: Identity is derived from the JWT context and all goal, account, and transaction source paths are ownership-scoped.

evidence: finalsource/be/src/modules/goal/goal.service.ts:72-83 filters owned Saving goals to valid ranges overlapping the current month
finalsource/be/src/modules/goal/goal.service.ts:81-83 selects latest startDate then highest goalId
requirements.rationale: The selected Saving goal is eligible and deterministic.

evidence: finalsource/be/src/modules/goal/goal.service.ts:84-94 retrieves all owned ExpenseLimit rows with startDate <= endDate and current-month overlap
The query has no result-collapsing operation, so every eligible persisted goal remains represented once
requirements.rationale: Expense-goal eligibility is enforced by owner, type, valid range, and overlap.

evidence: finalsource/be/src/modules/goal/goal.service.ts:109-123 loads owned-account transactions inside the inclusive Saving-goal/current-month intersection
finalsource/be/src/modules/goal/goal.service.ts:125-130 and 181-190 compute revenue minus expense without clamping and preserve zero sums
requirements.rationale: Saving progress uses exactly the owned overlap set and preserves negative and zero values.

evidence: finalsource/be/src/modules/goal/goal.service.ts:132-152 derives each goal/month intersection and sums only owned matching-category Expense transactions
finalsource/be/src/modules/goal/goal.service.ts:144-152 returns the empty-set sum as zero
requirements.rationale: Each currentExpense is restricted by ownership, category, type, and the inclusive goal/month overlap.

evidence: finalsource/be/src/modules/goal/goal.service.ts:143-163 trims resolved category names, uses Uncategorized for null IDs, and Unknown for unresolved or blank non-null categories
finalsource/be/src/modules/goal/goal.service.ts:161-162 and 186-187 apply round2 to all returned monetary values
requirements.rationale: Category labels and monetary response fields follow the required normalization rules.

evidence: finalsource/be/src/modules/goal/goal.service.ts:167-179 sorts exceeded goals first, then endDate, target amount, and goal ID ascending
finalsource/be/src/modules/goal/goal.service.ts:192 returns DTOs in the sorted order
requirements.rationale: The expense-goal priority order and all deterministic tie-breakers are implemented.
